note: Photo calibration. limb: the Earth edge (thin bright line) left to right; glowTop: top of the air glow, stars stay above it; geo: quadratic lat/lon to pixel fit from 16 city lights (rms 13 px); lift, liftPow: the flight path rises lift * altitude_km ^ liftPow photo px (a soft curve, so the climb off the pad reads); frame: pads left of eastX (fraction of the width, the west coast and Texas) are framed closer, zoom times the cover fit, with the pad at padX, padY of the hero; ext: photo px of the photo's own open Pacific strip, moved west of its left edge, so that framing never shows a band.
